-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Cherry Blossom Magic.png  |title= Cherry Blossom Magic |kanji= 桜魔法 |romaji= Sakura Mahō |english= Cherry Blossom Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Kirsch Vermillion }} {{Nihongo|Cherry Blossom Magic|桜魔法|Sakura Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate cherry blossoms.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate cherry blossoms at will. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spel
    Dense swarms of cherry blossoms can be used to create illusions and to obscure opponents' vision and mana-sensing, thus concealing the user and their allies, as well as disorienting opponents. Additionally, the individua
